notes.title: Decreased the build size from 5GB to 1GB!!
notes.content:
- Added Enhanced Combat Maneuvers
- Added more non combat modules.
- Improved the icon radar system.
- [b]Decreased the build size from 5GB to 1GB!![/b]

notes.title: Added a second tutorial for advanced features
notes.content: Added a second tutorial for advanced features.

notes.title: Patch 7/11/2025 - Tutorial fixes, and other Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Various improvements to the base tutorial.
[*] Added a new Tutorial level called "Camera Controls"
[*] Rebalanced and fixed dialogue in the tutorials
[*] Added a stub for a new tutorial for advanced controls
[*] Added asteroids to Ship Radar.
[*] Fixed some UI bugs
[*] Added the ability to left click objects to interact with them (talk/fight only).
[/list]

notes.title: Update 6/24/2025
notes.content:
- Rebalanced some Feats for level up, to make them more useful.
- Rebalanced Drone module availability
- Nerfed Federation Drones slightly.
- Fixed some bugs introduced in the previous update.

notes.title: Update (6/11/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Hard mode.
[*] Reorganized Abilities
[*] Add the Drone Fleet Ability
[*] Minor UI changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update (6/5/2025) - More weapons
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Drone Bays as an equip able weapon, that can be assigned to your turrets. There are small, medium, and large drone bays, in Cartel/Rakir/Federation flavors for variety.
[*] Added the Energy Vampire Weapon to the game.
[*] Improved the station market UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Update (6/4/2025)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the Siphon ability to Hextech II.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update (6/3/2025) - Bugfixes and 2 new abilities
notes.content:
Improvements:
[list]
[*] Added the Bombardment Killtech ability.
[*] Added the Light Entity Killtech ability.
[*] Fixed the Missiles and Muffins Grandson mission, which was not working.
[*] Missiles and Muffins will now help heal the player.
[/list]

Fixed bugs reported by Pravatus: 
[list]
[*] Context menu blocked when talking to Missiles and Muffins, and The Ghosts in S04.
[*] The Capital Ship Hybrid could not be targeted by enemies.
[*] The experience cap was behaving erratically.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch: Ui and portraits 5/30/2025
notes.content:
- Updated the UI for new game creation to be clearer.
- Updated some portraits
- Rebalanced deployables by making the hull repair depot available earlier.

notes.title: Patch - 5/30/2025: Bug fixes.
notes.content:
- Fixed a UI bugs locking the camera controls.
- Updated some portraits.

notes.title: Patch 5/29/2025 - v0.915B: +Twisted Sons Vignette
notes.content:
- Added a new Vignette for the Twisted Sons. The Viceroy and Twisted Sons' game starts both have a unique Vignette (introductory sequence) now. TODO: Guild of Eyes, and the Terrestrial Order.
- Fixed a UI bugs related to the UI locking after level up.
- Fixed a UI bug allowing the player to issue movement commands through open menus.
- Reworked Sector 00 to be more interesting.
- Restyled General Reade and his personal ship.
- Added the 'Protect' fleet command.

notes.title: Patch 5/22/2025
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue causing the Escape Menu to appear underneath other menus, reported by user [i]LLIOPOX[/i].
- Added visualizations to the Hull/Shield/Energy Repair Depots used by enemy factions, to helps players recognize the need to target them.

notes.title: Patch: 5/21/2025
notes.content:
- Added faction drones for the Federation, and Cartel, which they now use.
- Buffed Cartel Stations with cartel drones, in Sector02.
- Added new patrols to Sector 02.
- Made the final mission of the Tutorial easier.
- Fixed a bug preventing the right click menu from showing.

notes.title: Bug fix: 5/20/2025
notes.content: - Fixed an issue reported by [i]pravataus[/i], causing the right click Context Menu to stop working in a variety of situations.

notes.title: Patch 5/16/2025
notes.content: - Made the Advanced Drone Dock support recruitment directly from the structure, as per feedback from user [i]FiveThirteen[/i].

notes.title: Patch 5/15/2025:
notes.content: - Fixed a bug reported by [i]DougJunior[/i], that caused the player to get stuck on a permanent black screen.

notes.title: Update 5/13/2025
notes.content:
Made various changes to the tutorial based on player feedback.
- Added new text prompts about missing features
- Extended turret range
- Made the advanced drone dock easier to use
- Made a number of changes to prevent users from accidentally pausing (freezing) their game, and ordering their characters to move during cutscenes by spam clicking at the beginning of the level.
- Made the final mission of the tutorial easier.
- Other changes.
